title: Walk-In Clinic in Cabo San Lucas | Doctor Visit $99
description: Walk-in clinic in downtown Cabo San Lucas: see an English-speaking doctor for $99 USD, get your prescription filled, or have the doctor come to your hotel.

intro: When you feel well enough to leave your room but need a doctor today, a walk-in clinic is usually the fastest and most affordable option. Our clinic is in downtown Cabo San Lucas, on Francisco I. Madero in Centro, and a consultation with an English-speaking doctor costs $99 USD.
If you would rather not go out — or you cannot — the same doctors come to your hotel, villa or yacht 24/7 for $199 USD.

sections.h2: What to expect at our clinic
list: An English-speaking doctor with a Mexican Cédula Profesional — you can meet our medical team before you come.
A clear price in US dollars: $99 USD for the consultation. Medicines are extra.
Prescriptions written on the spot when needed, and medicines from our pharmacy.
An itemized invoice in English and USD for your travel insurance.
p_after: Message us on WhatsApp before you come and we will tell you the current wait and how to find us.

list: Fever, cough, sore throat or flu-like symptoms
Bad sunburn, rashes and insect bites
Prescription refills for medicines you ran out of

sections.h2: Walk-in clinic or a doctor at your hotel?
p: Both get you the same doctors. Choose the clinic ($99) if you can walk in easily and want the lowest price. Choose a house call ($199) if you have a fever, vomiting, small children, mobility problems, or simply do not want to leave your room. At night, the house call is usually the simplest option.
Dehydrated after a stomach bug, the sun or a long night? Our IV drips cost $129 to $159 + tax at the clinic, or from $159 + tax at your door. See the full IV therapy menu.
Chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, fainting, severe bleeding or a serious injury need an emergency room — call 911.

faq.q: Is there a walk-in clinic in Cabo San Lucas?
faq.a: Yes. Our clinic is on Francisco I. Madero in downtown Cabo San Lucas. A consultation with an English-speaking doctor is $99 USD.

faq.q: How much does a walk-in doctor cost in Cabo?
faq.a: With us, $99 USD at the clinic or $199 USD for a doctor at your hotel, villa or yacht. Medicines are extra.
No, but a quick WhatsApp message at +52 624 226 1023 lets us tell you the current wait. You can also book a time online.

faq.q: Can the clinic give me a prescription?
faq.a: Yes. Our doctors can prescribe after the consultation, and our pharmacy can fill it right away or deliver it to your hotel.
